caption: Child support is the one line I never question. What's the line you never question?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R10 800
p/m wages
Living in Piet Retief
slides.body:
Male, 25
Single, one baby girl (1) who lives with her mom
Job: Forestry worker, timber plantation
Net wages: R10 800 p/m

slides.title: Child support
slides.includes: My share of her mom's rent, nappies, formula
slides.body: I pay it on the 25th. I'd pay it even if no one asked.

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Room in a worker's hostel, prepaid electricity
slides.body: It's close to the plantation and I walk to work.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Boxer, mostly pap, chicken and a bit of meat
slides.body: I'm on my feet from 5 am. I eat a lot.

slides.title: Taxi fare
slides.includes: Weekends home to Wakkerstroom to see her
slides.body: Two taxis and a long wait. R1 300 for two days with my girl.

slides.title: Cigarettes & drinks
slides.includes: Packs, a few beers on Friday
slides.body: It's the number I don't want to look at.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Funeral policy, stokvel, airtime & data, clothing account, boots, toiletries
slides.body: The stokvel is only R200 but the group has helped me twice already. I'm not skipping a month.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R10 800. About R10 a day. Anything over that is borrowed from next month.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statements to Beyond Horizon and saw the drinks and cigarettes added up.

R1 100 was more than I thought.

No bank login needed.
